description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeJobDetailModel class within an HR management system. It models detailed information about an employee's job details, including associated properties like job title, employment status, location, and termination records. The class implements serialization traits and specifies how to extract and label data from Employee entity instances for API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeJobDetailModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing employee job details for API output, utilizing traits and specifying data extraction filters and attribute mappings from an Employee entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an Employee entity, setting up filters and attribute-to-property mappings for serialization.
